newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA INSURANCE IN TALKS, URGES CAUTION.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA INSURANCE IN TALKS, URGES CAUTION.

text.p: Botswana Insurance Holdings on Wednesday warned shareholders it was in talks which, if successully concluded, could have an effect on its share price on the Botswana Stock Exchange.
The group gave no further details in a short announcement, but market sources said the group was about to restructure its operations.
BIHL is 25.4 percent owned by general insurer St Paul Holdings of Minnessota (United States), while 31.6 percent is held by South Africa's African Life Assurance Co.
The sources said St Paul and African Life were believed to each want to take a greater interest in their own areas of expertise.
BIHL shares were untraded on the BSE on Wednesday at 305 thebe.
In the year to March 31 1997, the firm reported pre-tax earnings of 5.9 million pula compared with 628,000 pula a year ago.
